| description = 

Very rarely, when wandering the Qeynos Hills, and other nearby zones, one may find a beast known as a rabid grizzly. Though these animals may not be so fun to kill as they can result in you getting [[Rabies]], or [[Holly Windstalker]]/[[Cros Treewind]] hunting you down.

On Green the PH is a brown bear (typically 1-2 levels higher compared to other brown bears).
